text: You want to return an item you just received: a laptop. You think that you ordered it around April 2023 but are not sure. You want to return it because you found a better deal elsewhere. You want to return it for a full refund. If it cannot be returned, see if it can be canceled.
zh: 您想退回最近收到的一个笔记本电脑。您认为您是在2023年4月左右订购的，但不确定。您想退回它，因为您在别处找到了更好的交易。您希望获得全额退款。如果无法退回，请查看是否可以取消。
